name: The random Classic Heroic and Mythic Dungeon Finder queues require the live average item level and PvE Power
contract: The live client allows Random Classic Dungeon Heroic (1258) from average item level 40 and Random Classic Dungeon Mythic (2258) from average item level 58 (C_LFG.RequiredRandomItemLevel) and PvE Power 350 (C_LFG.RequiredRandomPVEPower). Item level is the character sheet's average over every equipment slot but the shirt and tabard (sixteen while a two-hander is wielded without an off hand); PvE Power is the sum of the equipped items' PvE Power, capped at 495. A join that misses either requirement is refused and leaves the player out of the queue; a join that meets both queues the player. Heroic has no PvE Power requirement.
